propositions: _candidate_dicts appends the same decoded dict twice for single-object JSON: once from _all_json_objects and once from whole-text json.loads, creating parser-generated duplication

_select_and_validate validates both identical dicts into distinct Pydantic instances and uses identity (is not) as ambiguity test, incorrectly flagging equal-but-nonidentical objects as conflicting candidates
structured replies with exactly one JSON object falsely emit multiple-candidate warnings with semantically identical first/last values
candidate deduplication in discovery order must collapse value-equal dicts before validation while preserving order and last-valid-wins behavior for genuinely distinct candidates
the shared parse_structured boundary used by adapters and review/verification schemas depends on validated result/exception, not on duplicate validation counts or false ambiguity warnings
